notable_absence.finding: This page never gates the upgrade action itself on a capella-role:* value (scheduling is gated on manage-maintenance.md instead, which this page links to) - here roles appear only as a notification audience (notifiesRoleOn), not an authorization check. No support-plan or billing-plan gate on the upgrade mechanism itself is stated either (the only plan-tier variance found is a timing difference for free tier, captured above). Also notable: zero cloud-provider-specific behavior (no AWS/Azure/GCP distinction anywhere in this file) - upgrades are described as uniform across CSPs, unlike the backup/snapshot pages in this same batch.

cross_product_finding: Recurrence of the known server-version-string-citation anomaly (Couchbase Server 8.0 / 7.6 cited as discrete, dated releases with their own 36-month support clocks) on a page that is itself about Capella's own continuously-deployed maintenance-job mechanism - the anomaly here is structural, not incidental: Capella's upgrade policy is defined entirely in terms of the underlying Server version's release cadence and EOL date, so this page cannot avoid citing Server versions the way a pure UI-mechanics page could.
